grade.first_issue: No decisive defect; no grading-rule cap applies.
grade.summary: The submission correctly proves that the solutions are exactly f(x)=x+c with c≥0. It establishes orbit invariance of g=f−id, nonnegativity of g, equality of all positive values of g through a valid tail comparison on Ran(f), and then excludes coexistence of the values 0 and c by connectedness. The converse is also verified correctly.
strengths: Correctly derives f(f(y))=2f(y)−y and hence g(f(y))=g(y).
Correctly uses forward iterates to prove g≥0.
The comparison estimate on Ran(f) validly forces all positive defect values to coincide; the brief limiting inference is routine and justified by the unbounded forward orbit.
The openness and connectedness argument correctly rules out mixed defect values.
Both inequalities are checked correctly for f(x)=x+c.
